title: Grateful Dead Live at University Of Iowa Fieldhouse on 1982-08-10

ai_review.summary: Matrix blend delivers crystal‑clear sound of a smoking 1982 performance, with standout Stagger Lee, China > Rider, Lost Sailor and other classics.
ai_review.review: The show is described as “smoking” from start to finish, with high energy, tight playing and numerous highlight moments – especially the second set’s epic China > Rider and multiple soaring Jerry solos. The audience‑plus‑soundboard matrix mix is praised as seamless and beautiful, offering excellent clarity despite a few minor speed‑correction quirks.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating ~4.5/5, with the vast majority praising both performance and recording; only one outlier negative comment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: The matrix of audience (AUD) and soundboard (SBD) is described as seamless, crisp and beautiful; a few reviewers note minor speed‑correction issues but overall the mix is considered superb.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The setlist is praised for smooth transitions, especially a powerful second‑set flow and strong segues (e.g., China into Rider). The first set builds nicely and the encore closes with high energy.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His voice and guitar work are highlighted throughout; multiple reviewers call his solos "ripping" and note his phrasing as magical.
band_member_comments.Phil: Described as "raging" on bass, driving every song forward and delivering a powerful low‑end foundation.
band_member_comments.Bob: Praised for an exciting slide solo in Minglewood, lively banter, and strong rhythm contributions throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's vocals and B3 organ are called outstanding; keyboards are noted as a unique 1982 quality that shines on this performance.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann and Mickey Hart are called amazing, providing an energetic and solid rhythmic backbone.
